options.title: The impala
options.text: The cull was hard and quick. The meat fed the village through a lean season, and the plains grew back. Nobody at the reserve ever spoke of it as easy.

options.title: The impala
options.text: Truckloads of impala went north to new land. Years later, a ranger there wrote to say their herd had a name for the newcomers: “Ruth’s lot”.

options.title: The impala
options.text: The contraception programme was slow, and Amara published a paper on it. Other reserves still call to ask how it was done.

options.title: The village
options.text: The beehive fence still hums along the east boundary. The village sells its honey in town under a label with an elephant on it.

options.title: The village
options.text: Every raid was paid for, every time. The payments got smaller as the elephants found the grass on their own side of the fence.

options.title: The village
options.text: The east fence was mended again and again. Wanjiru never stopped reminding you how many times.

options.title: The lodge
options.text: When Hale & Partners collapsed, the lodge passed to the reserve. Its staff all come from the village now.

options.title: The lodge
options.text: Hale’s lodge stayed full and loud. Every season its share of the ticket money went somewhere far away.

options.title: The lodge
options.text: You built the reserve slowly, with your own money and your own hands. Nothing on the plains belongs to anyone else.

options.title: The lodge
options.text: One question about a broken pump changed everything. Victor Hale never smiled at you again.

options.title: Kito
options.text: Kito works at the clinic in town and visits once a year, always with terrible tea for Tendai.

options.title: Kito
options.text: Kito testified at the trial. He moved to the city afterwards, and nobody heard from him again.

options.title: The rhinos
options.text: The rhino mother and her calf are still in the north. The calf has a calf of her own now.

options.title: The rhinos
options.text: The north has no rhinos. Amara keeps a camera trap on the old path, just in case one walks in again.

options.title: Victor Hale
options.text: Victor Hale was convicted of running the poaching ring and of the sabotage that nearly killed the reserve. The east road is quiet at night now.

options.title: Victor Hale
options.text: Hale built his luxury camp on the northern land. The trucks on the east road never quite stopped.

options.title: Victor Hale
options.text: Hale never got the north. He never got past the new wire either. Nor did anyone else.

thriving.title: Thriving Wilderness
thriving.text: Ruth’s reserve is wild, healthy and loved by the people around it. Children from the village grow up wanting to be rangers. {player}, this is the place she dreamed of.

profitable.title: Profitable but Compromised
profitable.text: The reserve makes money, the visitors keep coming, and the accounts have never looked better. But some nights, on the east road, there are still trucks with no lights.

fortress.title: Fortress Reserve
fortress.text: Inside the wire the animals are safe and the grass is green. Outside it, the village has learned to live without you. Ruth’s reserve survived, but it stands alone.

credits.title: Thank you for playing
credits.text:
Reserve Manager. Story, art and music made for this game. Built with Phaser; font: Inter.

The reserve is still yours: keep playing as long as you like.
